title: GenerativeVerificationalism: A Paradigm Shift in the Humanities and Social Sciences Based on AIGC

contributions.purpose: 提出'可执行人文学'新方法论范式
contributions.mechanism: 主张理论的有效性须经其'可计算构建性'证明,研究目标从解释转向构建,AI agent充当形式化理论的执行者
contributions.evaluation: 定性/纯理论:论文明确声明不做任何模型的实证验证,仅作方法论倡议
contributions.domain: 人文社科方法论/计算社会科学
contributions.source_quote: we term and define here as "Executable Humanities": a novel methodological framework whose core principle is that the validity of a theory must be demonstrated through its computational constructability

contributions.purpose: 把范式分解为三条基础公设
contributions.mechanism: Formalization(概念可译为形式语言)、Generative Verification(构建即验证)、Predictive Dynamics(成熟理论须能建模系统演化并给可证伪预测)
contributions.evaluation: 定性:逐条陈述假设,无数学定理或证明(自承)
contributions.source_quote: We decompose this paradigm into three foundational postulates: the Formalization Postulate... the Generative Verification Postulate... and the Predictive Dynamics Postulate

contributions.purpose: 用RCL统一理论示范三公设可被实例化
contributions.mechanism: 把创造力/质量/传播力形式化为Rarity(-logP)/Entropy-control/Connectivity,给目标函数J(γ)与Langevin扩散方程
contributions.evaluation: 定性:自定位为'概念原型/思想实验',非经验验证的定论理论
contributions.source_quote: we position it as a methodological concept prototype. Its core value lies not in the correctness of its present conclusions, but in its function as a thought experiment

self_declared_provenance.quote: The epistemological foundation of traditional humanities and social sciences has largely been interpretive... To transcend this limitation, we argue that the concept of "understanding" must be given a more rigorous and constructivist standard.
